answer_2.quote: We score the referent descriptions generated by the CRDG based on their similarity to the manually constructed ground truth labels using the same metrics as reported in , i.e., the Jaccard index, BLEU (based on unigrams and bigrams), ROUGE-L, and cosine similarity between text embeddings (Cosine T T). When comparing generated REs against ground truth mentions, we compute unigram-based BLEU, ROUGE-L, and cosine similarity between text embeddings (Cosine T T). We report TIR performance in terms of top-1 accuracy, mean reciprocal rank (MRR), normalized discounted cumulative gain (NDCG), and cosine similarity between referent description text embeddings and target image embeddings (Cosine T I).
